auth.loginDescription: Nexora uses a device-bound passkey. No password or exchange credential is accepted.
auth.bootstrapDescription: Use the one-time token created locally, then register the first passkey.
auth.recoveryDescription: These single-use codes are shown once. Store them outside this browser before continuing.
auth.unavailable: Passkeys require a supported browser in a secure private origin.
auth.denied: The secure authentication request was not completed.
auth.failed: Authentication could not be completed. No credential was stored in the browser.

shell.title: Portfolio operations
shell.description: Owner-scoped portfolio value, immutable journal evidence, holdings and bounded reconciliation workflows in one private workspace.
shell.phaseTwo: Not included in the current stage

securityItems.forbidden: No live trading, wallet or exchange credentials

portfolioDashboard.title: Portfolio overview
portfolioDashboard.loadingDescription: Reading owner-scoped portfolio data without caching financial state.
portfolioDashboard.errorDescription: The private API could not return the portfolio registry. No data was changed.
portfolioDashboard.analyticsError: The selected portfolio analytics or valuation evidence could not be calculated.
portfolioDashboard.emptyDescription: Create the first owner-scoped portfolio through the registry API before using this dashboard.
portfolioDashboard.noAllocation: No priced position is available for allocation.
portfolioDashboard.valuationFootnote: Stale and missing evidence stays visible and keeps NAV explicitly incomplete.
portfolioDashboard.noAccounts: No account belongs to this portfolio.

analyticsState.stale: NAV includes stale valuation evidence. Review timestamps before using this snapshot.
analyticsState.missing: NAV is incomplete because one or more positions have no valid valuation evidence.

portfolioOperations.title: Journal, holdings and reconciliation
portfolioOperations.description: Review immutable evidence, rebuild derived projections and complete bounded import decisions without weakening the owner boundary.
portfolioOperations.noPortfolio: Select or register a portfolio before opening its accounting workspace.
portfolioOperations.loading: Loading owner-scoped journal and projection evidence…
portfolioOperations.loadError: The accounting workspace could not be loaded. No data was changed.
portfolioOperations.actionSucceeded: The requested transition completed and its evidence is now visible.
portfolioOperations.actionFailed: The requested transition was rejected safely
portfolioOperations.reasonRequired: Enter an owner reason of at least 8 characters.
portfolioOperations.reauthenticationRequired: Recent passkey authentication is required before this sensitive transition.

journal.title: Immutable transaction journal
journal.description: Balanced entries are read from the owner-scoped append-only ledger. Corrections remain explicit reversals or supersessions.
journal.empty: No transaction belongs to this portfolio.

holdings.title: Rebuildable holdings and lots
holdings.description: Derived positions remain tied to an exact journal checksum and cost-basis policy.
holdings.notBuilt: No projection exists for this method. Rebuild from the immutable journal to continue.
holdings.noLots: The projection contains no open lot.

imports.title: Dry-run import preview
imports.description: CSV and Nexora JSON are normalized deterministically before any publication is allowed.
imports.placeholder: Paste bounded CSV or Nexora JSON content
imports.dryRunNotice: Preview is mandatory. Quarantined rows and duplicates stay visible; partial publication is forbidden.
imports.empty: No import preview has been created yet.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation cases
reconciliation.description: Every difference requires an explicit, version-checked owner decision; no automatic journal correction is available.

states.loadingDescription: Checking the private runtime without exposing session material.
states.offlineDescription: The shell could not reach the private API. Data was not changed.
states.expiredDescription: Your server-side session is no longer valid. Sign in again with your passkey.
states.errorDescription: A bounded runtime error occurred. Reload to retry safely.
